I tend to think about imaginal practice in two basic categories: 

1) Respectable Practice

2) What-The-Fuck Practice
↓
1484869051541295109 [2022-01-22] @the_wilderless 💜 14
Respectable Practice is almost everything I see:

If someone walks in on you doing imaginal practice, and what they see is someone sitting and breathing with their eyes closed, that’s respectable.
↓
1484869249143226370 [2022-01-22] @the_wilderless 💜 19 🔁 1
WTF practices are the ones where if anyone sees you doing them, they will have no fucking clue what you’re doing and will probably think differently of you afterward.
↓
1484870057679327250 [2022-01-22] @the_wilderless 💜 31
I taught one of my favorite practices last month, I call it The Mead Hall. 

The short version is that you let your body, voice, and breath find a rhythm, and you up the intensity again and again until it takes you over.
↓
1484870059264778253 [2022-01-22] @the_wilderless 💜 26
If you see me doing this in full swing, it will basically look like me jumping and swaying and shouting a mix of rough sounds, rhyming couplets, and rhythmic notes in different registers.
↓
1484870522076897288 [2022-01-22] @the_wilderless 💜 22
The WTF practices tend to be much less common,,,

But hot damn if they don’t light folks on fire from the inside out when one clicks ❤️‍🔥

  [Quoting @RomeoStevens76: Why aren't I more clear-headed more of the time?  Completing the query "When I get really clear, the bad thing that happens is -" as fast as possible to clear the cache.  When I get really clear, I can't speak or write fast enough to communicate my experience  When I get really clear, I can't decide which of the threads I'm aware of to follow  When I get really clear, the bad thing that happens is I'm aware of how/when other people don't care about me  When I get really clear, goals seem composed of an overwhelming number of steps  When I get really clear, I'm aware that I can't control many of the things I care about  When I get really clear, I'm aware of preferences that I have that would hurt others  When I get really clear, I'm aware of effortful things I could do that would improve my situation (and therefore feel bad about not wanting to do them)  When I get really clear, I am aware of negative sensations in the body  When I get really clear, I become more disagreeable  When I get really clear, I become more dismissive of personality constructs, including others'  When I get really clear, I don't know what I want  When I get really clear, I need more time to digest experience and can't respond to everything immediately  When I get really clear, I'm aware of ways in which I am powerless  When I get really clear, I am aware that the situation in the world might have no winning moves  When I get really clear, I see others' suffering clearly  When I get really clear, ahhh (scrunched face)  When I get really clear, I can feel that my heart is small/tight  When I get really clear, some part scrabbles for ways to get less clear  When I get really clear, I can see that ill-will is a response to powerlessness  When I get really clear, I can see the lack of easy answers, and see that the easy answers are an excuse to stay in a comfortable loop  When I get really clear, I know that I will die  When I get really clear, I am aware that the things I am proud of are very reliant upon luck  When I get really clear, I know that being clear more of the time might result in some life changes, some of which I won't initially like  When I get really clear, I'm aware that what little control I have comes down to micro moments of decision, usually between more scripted patterns  When i get really clear, I'm aware that pain is inevitable  Phew, more there than I thought. No wonder.]
